headline: Current haze costs exceed RM 1.40 billion with rising health risks
summary: The haze episode from 2026-08-15 to 2026-10-16 has caused an estimated damage of RM 1.40 billion, with daily losses estimated at RM 22.2 million. API readings show eight of sixteen states unhealthy, highest in Johor, Negeri Sembilan and Selangor. Smoke‑source shares are from the September 2019 haze: West Kalimantan 35%, Malaysia domestic 18%, Riau 16%, Central Kalimantan 16%.
actions: Prioritise resource routing to Selangor, Johor and Sabah as health priority zones
Allocate emergency funds to mitigate estimated damage in Kuala Lumpur (RM 34.0 million), Selangor (RM 31.2 million) and Johor (RM 19.3 million) for the next 72 hours
Accelerate data collection to replace the 10 of 30 placeholder inputs in the damage model
